# 4 bed semi-detached house for sale

> Sherry FitzGerald Carroll are delighted to bring No 51 Marlmount Park to the market, a stunningly presented four bedroom semi detached family home offering a wealth of fine finishes and features. Marlmount is an exceptional development of exclusive family homes located in a privileged setting to the south of Dundalk on the Old Dublin Road, a short distance from the seaside village of Blackrock…

- Typ: semi-detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 4 bed

- Energetická náročnost: A2
- Lokalita: 51 Marlmount Park, Marlmount, Dundalk
